column2: Interim AI policies · honor code silent · Microsoft Copilot and others · four contradictions
column3: Under two interim policies, Georgia Tech sets AI rules for academic and research work through the Provost and for administration and employment through Administration and Finance. Undisclosed AI use counts as a possible Honor Code violation under the academic interim policy, and an AI Governance Program supports both policies. Board of Regents Policy 6.28 directs every University System of Georgia institution to integrate AI guidance into its integrity policies, yet the Georgia Tech Academic Honor Code contains no AI language. OIT encourages ChatGPT and Bing Chat on its Generative AI page, while the interim policies restrict employees to approved tools. Three AI committees and workgroups appear without published charges or reports, and the policy library pages were not read.
